customManagers.description: kind/up.sh pins what it installs in shell variables, which no manager reads. Each has a '# renovate:' comment on the line above it naming where its versions come from.

packageRules.description: What this demo exists to show: the registry, as an image and as the chart that pins that image, and the CLI and plugin a reader runs against it. Their own PR, never grouped with tooling, so CI's compose and kind jobs prove each bump before anyone reads the README against it. Not held for Monday: a release of ours is proposed at Renovate's next run.
appshell-controller releases on its own, so its chart has its own PR. Not held for Monday either.
The registry's tags are semver, prereleases included. Docker versioning reads -alpha.1 as a variant, like -alpine, so it would never offer the next release.
Held at 5.106: newer releases don't build with @module-federation/enhanced 2.9, as appshell-quickstart found.
Keycloak and MongoDB match what the hosted registry runs; a major is a decision.
Build tooling can't reach a reader's browser except through the build CI runs. One grouped PR a week.
The seed image's bases, pinned by digest: node builds it, distroless runs it. One PR for both, which CI builds and seeds with.
This repository releases the seed's image, and sets its version in compose.yaml before tagging it (.github/workflows/release.yml).
